questions.question: Shweta starts walking from her office and walks 150 m towards the south, then she turns right and walks 80 m, and then she turns left and walks 60 m. She finally turns left and walks 280 m to reach a bank. What is the shortest distance between her office and the bank?
questions.solution:
According to given conditions,

 
• Shweta starts walking from her office and walks 150 m towards the south. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8438b313c1b2c76f5ea6a6e7323098bd3b04d25c47116a696c5becad6cde2e4d.png] 

 
• Then she turns right and walks 80 m.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ad02ca9b994e621511f8bbbadb09adb3737dca73f92110fa14fd472f1a9d2a22.png] 

 
• Then she turns left and walks 60 m.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4e8864a88434acaa333cbedb8763a6cf017c64bc3ddfbaaa0262668ec5c1a23f.png] 

 
• She finally turns left and walks 280 m to reach a bank.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b1c41d249fc8bd4952913174aed3553bcc767d8afc8c4f28ea5c0beb5fcee4d6.png] 

Now, the shortest distance between Shweta's office and bank can be calculated by the **pythagoras theorem** :-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/31a9d755959342eb7851ba5424d209dc084f4c9da744d89599727b8f8a944bbf.png] 

⇒ Here, x stands for shortest distance.

So, (x)² = (60 + 150)² + (280 - 80)²

⇒ (x)2 = (210)2 + (200)2

⇒ (x)2 = 44100 + 40000

⇒ (x)2 = 84100

⇒ **x = 290 M**

Hence, **"290 m"** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
If '@' means 'addition', '%' means 'multiplication', '$' means 'division' and '#' means 'subtraction', then find the value of the following expression. 

126 $ 7 % 3 @ 19 # 21
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ebadc30a979bf1a7e953d20901c3e7953c575296c0e0bb4af8a458ec3a64ab2c.png] 

According to the question,

 
 

 
 
Symbol

 
 
 
**@**

 
 
 
**%**

 
 
 
**$**

 
 
 
#

 
 
 

 
 
Meaning

 
 
 
**+**

 
 
 
×

 
 
 
÷

 
 
 
**-**

 
 
 

Given that: **126 $ 7 % 3 @ 19 # 21**

After replacing the symbols with their meanings, we get :-

__**126 **____**÷ 7**__ × 3 + 19 - 21

= __**18 **____**× 3**__ + 19 - 21 

= __**54 **____**+ 19**__ - 21

= 73 - 21

= **52**

Hence, the correct answer is **"52"**.

Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

questions.solution:
Given: P Q _ Q P P Q R _ P P Q R Q _ P Q R Q _

By checking options:-

 
• Q R P P → P Q __**Q**__ Q P P Q R __**R**__ P P Q R Q __**P**__ P Q R Q __**P **__→ (It doesn't Follows the pattern)
 
• R Q P P → P Q **__R__** Q P P Q R **__Q__** P P Q R Q __P__ P Q R Q __P __→ **(**It follows the pattern of : PQRQP - PQRQP - PQRQP - PQRQP)
 
• P Q R P → P Q **__P__** Q P P Q R **__Q__** P P Q R Q **__R__** P Q R Q __P __→ (It doesn't Follows the pattern)
 
• P P R Q → P Q __P__ Q P P Q R **__P__** P P Q R Q __R__ P Q R Q __**Q** __→ (It doesn't Follows the pattern)

Option (2) gives a pattern of P Q __R__ Q P - P Q R __Q__ P - P Q R Q __P__ - P Q R Q __P__

Hence, the correct answer is **"R Q P P"**.
